notes: Synthetic, from platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors (409 conflict_error, which the page documents and the OpenAPI spec lists for POST /v1/messages; the message is the page's description); request_id invented. Not recordable: nothing in a Messages request induces it on demand.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap X4: mapAnthropicStatus maps by error type and ignores the HTTP status, so an error type it does not list falls back to 502 upstream_error, which the router retries, fails over and counts against the circuit breaker: conflict_error is a client error that a retry on another provider cannot fix
